lines: As real and unreal carry no mark between them, in own self —
so inert and non-inert carry none. This stands certain.
sanskrit_cite: yathā sadasatām naiva viśeṣo 'sti nijātmani jadājaḍānām apy evaṃ nāsty asāv iti niścayaḥ

lines: Appearing, describing — being, and non-being its reverse —
none of it touches own-form. That essence faces the knower.
sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyā ca sattā yad yad asattā viparyayaḥ naitat svarūpaṃ spṛśati vastuno jñātṛgāmy adaḥ

lines: A thing's self can never be mere object of showing-telling:
it leans on another, keeps no single form, oversteps being.
sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyāviṣayatāpy arthasyātmā na yujyate parāpekṣitayā naikarūpatve sattvalaṅghanāt

lines: Granted — let no mark stand. Yet here a difference succeeds,
from appearing's coming and going — and that much serves the end.
sanskrit_cite: mā bhūd viśeṣaḥ prakhyādibhāvābhāvau tataḥ punaḥ siddhyaty eva viśeṣo 'tra tāvatā ca prayojanam

lines: Even so, being fits only as bound to appearing —
cut from that tie, thing and unthing stay one blur.
sanskrit_cite: evam apy avabhāsānuṣaktā sattocitā bhavet tadapekṣāṃ vinā bhāvābhāvayor aviśiṣṭatā

lines: But how keep they one, when the existent performs its function,
and the other does not? — Yet the thing, in own self, stays without mark.
sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ syād aviśeṣo 'tra yāvatārthakriyāṃ hi san kuryān nānyas tathāpy artho nirviśeṣo nijātmani

lines: Steeped in the working-shine dye, the existent would subsist
by its own form — yet differ from the non-existent nowhere.
sanskrit_cite: evam arthakriyābhāsopādhisaṃbhedam āgataḥ sann arthaḥ syāt svarūpeṇa nāsatas tu viśiṣyate

lines: But even there, no working is declared of the already-proven thing —
the two run level. So their ground stands on awareness.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpy arthakriyā siddhasattākārthe na varṇitā samam evānayos tena pratiṣṭhā saṃvidāśrayā

lines: And were awareness ungrasping in its very form,
it too would rank with non-being, with the inert — as before.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvid apy aparāmarśarūpā cet tad asāv api abhāvena jaḍenātha tulyaiva prāgvad ātmani
